# arya.wtf

> Founder of Elux Space, an AI-native design studio in Yogyakarta. I help owners decide what AI should automate, what it should assist, and what it should never touch.

Arya Pradana. Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Building software companies since 2008. Founder and CEO of Elux Space (Feb 2022–), a UI/UX and product design studio that went from 18 people (2023–24) to 12 (2025) to 4 (2026) with revenue unchanged from 2025. Former COO of DOT Indonesia (2015–2020, ~50 people). S1 Teknik Informatika, ITS (2006–2011). S2 Business, SBM ITB (2016–2018).

## Method
- [Three verdicts](https://arya.wtf/method): every piece of work is sorted into automate, assist, or leave alone.

## Pages
- [The record](https://arya.wtf/about): the 18-year timeline, Side A (2006–2020) and Side B (2020–now).
- [Work](https://arya.wtf/work): own builds — arya-taste, vimemory, Esflows, mrktelx, OpenClaw, ERPS.
- [The log](https://arya.wtf/log): dated verdict entries with eight fixed fields. Rule: no number, no entry.
- [Hire](https://arya.wtf/hire): AI decision audit for owners, from IDR 10,000,000. Elux Space team quoted per project on https://elux.space.
- [Now](https://arya.wtf/now): what he is doing this quarter, dated.
